JDK 9/10 activate neither profile and silently compile nothing. JDK 17 is inside the multi-release band and is one of the three JDKs (8, 17, 25) the project's own CI (.github/workflows/build.yml) tests on every push across ubuntu/windows/macOS. CI runs `mvn -X compile -B --file pom.xml` then `mvn -X verify -B --file pom.xml`; statusCheckRollup for this run's HEAD sha is SUCCESS. Test command avoids package/verify/install phases because those additionally trigger japicmp-maven-plugin (downloads previously-released jsoup 1.23.1 from Maven Central for a binary-compat check independent of code under test), maven-javadoc-plugin, maven-bundle-plugin, and central-publishing-maven-plugin; pom has no jacoco plugin configured so its goals are invoked directly from the CLI. `mvn test` alone only runs surefire; failsafe (netty-based integration tests) is bound to `verify` and excluded by default via failsafe.excludedGroups=long-running, so plain `mvn test` needs no network ports."}

Could not pick and probe a specific older sha within the 6-month mining window to confirm the recipe holds across history -- only the given HEAD sha (19c758e2e4abc6a1f52193ceab09c22a7c010f8b) was actually probed via jvm_build_probe. Cross-history validity rests on CI-matrix + pom profile-activation reading at HEAD, plus a prior run's independent probe success at a different jsoup HEAD (46b620860af930eedc193a705eaf7cea5aec89a6, per repo notes, not re-verified this run since notes are not evidence).
